meaning.en: Brihaspati said
Kurukshetra, the sacrificial ground of the gods
the place of sacrifice for the gods
the abode of Brahman
as the life-breaths are departing
Rudra reveals the crossing-mantra, the liberating Brahman
meaning.hi: रुद्र तारक ब्रह्म का उपदेश देते हैं

meaning.en: becoming immortal, one attains liberation
meaning.hi: अमर होकर मोक्ष प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: one should serve the never-forsaken place (Kashi) alone
meaning.hi: अविमुक्त क्षेत्र की ही सेवा करे

meaning.en: one should never abandon the never-forsaken place

meaning.en: Bharadwaja asked
what is the crossing-mantra
what does it carry across
the eight-syllabled mantra of salutation to Narayana
to be worshipped as pure consciousness itself
Om, the single syllable, is the form of the self
namah, the two syllables, is the form of nature
narayanaya, the five syllables, is the form of the highest Brahman
whoever knows this becomes immortal
meaning.hi: जो यह जानता है वह अमर हो जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Om, this syllable, is the highest Brahman
meaning.hi: ॐ, यह अक्षर, परम ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: it is the subtle eight-syllabled form
the sound A is the first syllable
the sound U is the second syllable
the sound M is the third syllable
the bindu is the fourth syllable
the nada is the fifth syllable
the kala is the sixth syllable
kalatita is the seventh syllable
what lies beyond it is the eighth syllable
meaning.hi: उससे परे का आठवाँ अक्षर है

meaning.en: because it carries one across, it is called taraka
meaning.hi: पार कराने के कारण तारक कहलाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: Om, this syllable, is the highest Brahman (restated)
meaning.hi: ॐ, यह अक्षर, परम ब्रह्म है (पुनः कथित)

meaning.en: this alone should be worshipped
it unfolds into eight parts
meaning.hi: यह आठ भागों में प्रकट होता है

meaning.en: the sounds A, U, M
the dot, the resonance, the trace, the beyond-trace
know this itself to be the crossing Brahman

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: from the sound A, Brahma arose
known there by the name Jambavan
arisen from the sound U

meaning.en: arisen from the sound M

meaning.hi: शिव, हनुमान के रूप में स्मृत

meaning.en: the bindu, called there by the name Ishvara

meaning.en: the nada should be known as the great lord

meaning.en: Bharata, called there by the name Shankhanama

Lakshmana, the one who bears the earth

meaning.en: kalatita, the goddess herself
known by the name Sita

meaning.en: this syllable Om is everything that exists
meaning.hi: यह अक्षर ॐ ही यह सब कुछ है

meaning.en: what has been, what is, what will be
the truth, the mantra, the letter, the deity, the meter
the hymn, the sound-fragment, the power, the very act of creation
whoever knows this

meaning.en: reveals His own true form
He who is the glorious Supreme Self, Narayana
that Lord addressed through the sound A, Jambavan
earth, sky, and heaven
to Him, salutations again and again

meaning.en: so it should be seen in every mantra

meaning.en: that Lord beyond all this, the highest of all persons

eternally pure, awake, free, true, supreme, boundless, undivided, whole
meaning.hi: नित्यशुद्ध, बुद्ध, मुक्त, सत्य, परम, अनन्त, अद्वय, परिपूर्ण

meaning.en: whoever studies this eight-fold mantra
meaning.hi: जो इस आठ-भाग वाले मंत्र का अध्ययन करता है

meaning.en: becomes purified by fire
meaning.hi: अग्नि से शुद्ध हो जाता है

meaning.en: becomes known to all the gods
meaning.hi: सभी देवताओं द्वारा जाना जाता है

meaning.en: the merit of chanting Gayatri a hundred thousand times is gained
meaning.hi: गायत्री के लाख जाप का फल प्राप्त होता है

meaning.en: it purifies ten generations before and ten after
meaning.hi: दस पीढ़ियों को आगे-पीछे शुद्ध करता है

meaning.en: attains the realm of Narayana
meaning.hi: नारायण के पद को प्राप्त करता है

meaning.en: the wise always see that highest step of Vishnu
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी सदा विष्णु के उस परम पद को देखते हैं

meaning.en: as one sees the open sky
